findings.detail: The HydroSource Logistics warrant source row reports fair value 210,328, but the extracted fair_value is 0.0.

rationale: C104 flagged a zero fair_value in the extracted holding. The source SOI row for HydroSource Logistics, LLC warrant shows 0.0% of net assets, par/shares 380, amortized cost as a dash, and fair value 210,328. The zero appears to come from the percent-of-net-assets field or the dash/cell alignment rather than the fair_value column, so the extracted fair_value of 0.0 is a real localized extraction error.
